description:
## Finding
\`ls /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/rust_out\` shows a 3.9 MB executable file in the repo root. It is gitignored (\`/.gitignore:rust_out\`) and not tracked, but its presence is noise.

The file looks like a stray rust binary, possibly from \`cargo run\` outside the workspace target/ dir or a test debug emit.

## Why P3
- Cosmetic — does not affect builds or correctness.
- Confusing for fresh checkouts where this file is absent — readers seeing it on Mark's machine may assume it's a build artifact they should reproduce.

## Fix
Delete \`rust_out\` from the working tree. Investigate where it came from (likely a stray output from a one-off compile). The pattern \`rust_out\` in \`.gitignore\` suggests it has happened before; consider broader pattern \`/rust_out*\` to cover variants.

## Scope reference
\`/home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/rust_out\` (untracked but present).
title: P3: stray rust_out binary in repo root not gitignored properly
